text: If a spectral sequence converges to $H^n$, then it determines $H^n$ completely, including how the graded pieces $E_\infty^{p,q}$ assemble into $H^n$.
explanation: False: convergence recovers only the associated graded pieces $E_\infty^{p,q}\cong F^pH^{p+q}/F^{p+1}H^{p+q}$. Reassembling those pieces into $H^n$ is a separate, possibly nontrivial extension problem that the spectral sequence does not resolve on its own.
